fields.name: site
fields.label: Site
fields.schema_description: Site used to select network devices for validation.

options.notes: useEnvData requests /v1/parameter/location?location_type=Site&location_type=Module (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:34-41); the repeated location_type key is an array, which v1 OptionSource.params (scalar values only) cannot express. Rows are mapped by mapLocationOptions (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:25-36): label = name, value = 'dcim-location:' + JSON [location_type, id] when the row has a location_type, otherwise the bare id. The encoded value is UI-only and is decoded back to id + location_type before use (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:39-59).

fields.query_param_normalization: Single value (searchParams.get('site'), ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:91). Resolved by resolveLocationFormValue against option value (encoded), provider id, or display name, first match wins; unmatched gives "" (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:110-115). Re-applied on each sync-effect run until the first manual change.
fields.submit_transform: Decoded to the provider id: resolveLocationOption(siteData, data.site)?.id ?? data.site (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:144-146).

fields.name: roles
fields.label: Roles
fields.schema_description: Device roles used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (searchParams.getAll('role'), ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:92). The param name 'role' differs from the field name 'roles'. Values are kept only if they equal an option key (role name); unknown values are dropped (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:71-82, 116).
client_only_validation: zod coerces a non-array value to [] (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:42-45).

fields.name: status
fields.label: Device Status
fields.schema_description: Device statuses used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (searchParams.getAll('status'), ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:93). Values are kept only if they equal an option key (status name). If none remain, the field falls back to ["Active", "Provisioned"] (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:101, 117-123).
client_only_validation: min(1) 'Device Status is required' (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:46-49). The schema allows an empty list.

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant
fields.schema_description: Tenant used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Single value (searchParams.get('tenant'), ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:94). Matched against option key (tenant name); an unmatched value gives "" (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:59-68, 124-129).
fields.submit_transform: data.tenant || undefined, so the key is omitted from the JSON when empty (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:150).

fields.name: site_type
fields.schema_description: DCIM location type for the site identifier.
fields.submit_transform: location_type of the selected location option (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:144, 147); undefined, so omitted from the JSON, when the option has no type. The server pairs it with site by the '<field>_type' naming convention (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/workflow_submission.py:163-168).

fields.name: device_type_ids
fields.schema_description: Device type identifiers used to filter network devices.

fields.name: raise_for_invalid
fields.schema_description: Whether invalid hardware should fail the workflow.

payload_transform: onSubmit (ui/src/app/workflows/cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow/form/cumulus-hardware-validation-form.tsx:142-168) builds {site: location?.id ?? data.site, site_type: location?.locationType, roles, status, tenant: data.tenant || undefined, device_type_ids: [], raise_for_invalid: false} in that key order. JSON.stringify drops site_type when the location has no type, and drops tenant when it is empty. The body is POSTed through startWorkflow('/v1/workflow/ngc/cumulus_hardware_validation') (ui/src/lib/utils.tsx:153-184), which navigates to /workflows/{id} on success. Errors produce a destructive toast (getErrorMessage) and are not rethrown; isSubmitting is reset afterwards. cumulusHardwareValidationForm.spec.ts:112-119, 201-208, 322-333 and 491-498 assert the body. Mock locations have no location_type, so site_type never appears in tests.
discrepancies: status: the UI requires at least one value, but the schema allows [] (default ["Active", "Provisioned"]).

The UI default statuses live in a separate constant (ui/src/lib/workflow-defaults.ts:18) that duplicates the Python default (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/cumulus_hardware_validation.py:84). They match today.

An empty tenant is omitted rather than sent as null (schema default null), and a missing site_type is omitted rather than sent as null. The meaning is the same, but a schema-default renderer would send different bytes.
device_type_ids and raise_for_invalid are hidden and hardcoded to their schema defaults.
Roles, statuses and tenants offered are limited to managed roles/tenants and dcim.device statuses. The schema accepts free strings.
The workflow class is ValidateHardwareWorkflow, but the slug is cumulushardwarevalidationworkflow, not the lowercased class name (ui/src/config/site.ts:140-142).
The role query param ('role') does not match the field name ('roles').
Playwright never exercises encoded location values or site_type (ui/src/mocks/data/formData.ts:26-39).
contract_gaps: site_reference has to fill the sibling field site_type from the selected option, because the server reads '<field>_type' (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/workflow_submission.py:163-168). v1 cannot declare that a widget writes a second field, or hide site_type, so a generic form would render site_type as a free-text nullable field.
OptionSource.params is scalar-only, but the location source needs the repeated location_type=Site&location_type=Module.
The location option value is a UI-encoded composite (dcim-location:[location_type,id]). A single value_key cannot express it.

device_type_ids and raise_for_invalid are hidden today. v1 has no hidden hint, so a generic form would render tags and a boolean. Their defaults equal the hardcoded values, so the payload stays the same.
Multi-value query prefill (repeated role= and status=), matching by option key, and the fallback to the schema default when nothing matches are not expressible. UiHint.query_param is just a name.
The client-only status min(1) has no v1 hint. Expressing it would need a schema minItems change, which is out of scope.
tenant and site_type are anyOf[T, null], so the renderer needs a nullable-scalar rule.
